Game Overview

In Ellie and Friends Venice Carnival, the core idea is straightforward: immerse yourself in the dazzling Venice Carnival. Design stunning outfits for Ellie and her friends using luxurious costumes and unique Venetian masks. Showcase your creativity with an intuitive interface, mixing and matching for the perfect style score. Embrace the enchanting festival atmosphere with every elegant design choice.
